resources.string: Your addresses that %1$s can trust, and addresses for other assistants.

Your addresses that are not connected to Mailr, such as a work account. Each address counts only after you confirm it with a code, and only for mail verified by its own domain. Mail from these addresses then counts as yours in standing orders.

resources.string: Notes you forward from these addresses are handled by %1$s under the standing order “Follow my forwarded notes”.

Your addresses that another assistant reads and acts on, such as an alias for a separate assistant. Mail sent only to these addresses is skipped by standing orders, so two assistants never act on the same forward. An order that names the address in its search still runs.
None. Standing orders run on mail to all your addresses.
